cons.intro: What each permission does and what is stored. Changes may ask you to log in again.
cons.core_learning.what: Required. Answers and progress are saved so the next lesson can be chosen.
cons.core_learning.stored: Stored: nickname, class, language, answers, written explanations, progress.
cons.core_learning.off: Can't be turned off; delete the account to stop.
cons.voice_input.what: Your child can answer by speaking; speech is turned into text.
cons.voice_input.stored: Recordings are never kept; they're deleted once the text is made.
cons.voice_input.off: When off, the mic is hidden and your child types.
cons.guardian_view.what: You see a progress summary: what's mastered, what needs practice, which days they learned.
cons.guardian_view.stored: Conversations and answers are not shown.
cons.guardian_view.off: When off, the dashboard shows no progress.
cons.pilot_research.what: Results are included in our study of whether TutorFren helps children learn.
cons.pilot_research.stored: Scores and progress only, without names. Never voice.
cons.pilot_research.off: The app works the same when off.
